maps.points.mausoleum_2.a02.title: Go upstairs → Mausoleum Entrance
maps.points.mausoleum_2.detail: Unlike the rest of the mausoleum, this chamber is almost neat. Red tapestries hang like silent witnesses.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.detail-5: Torchlight reveals a man slumped against the chamber wall, his wrists chained to the stone.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.detail-7: Talrik's golden key, Staff of the Archmage, Crimson Ring
maps.points.mausoleum_2.detail-8: Step on the sensor at (12, 2), and continue with the higher-level priest event.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue: Unlike the rest of the mausoleum, this chamber is almost neat. Red tapestries hang like silent witnesses.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-11: "By light and law, your soul is forfeit."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-15: Choose “Quick shot. Aim for the heart.”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-16: You draw and release in one smooth breath. The arrow cuts through the haze and strikes his chest.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-17: It splinters. Thalric barely moves, a crooked smile spreading across his face.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-18: "Was that supposed to hurt?" he sneers. "Pain left me years ago... you'll learn why."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-19: Choose “These markings... it was a blood rite. He changed himself.”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-2: In the corners, four braziers burn with sickly green flame, their glow painting every stone with an unnatural pallor. At the center, a desk drowned in scrolls, melted candles, and blood streaked notes. Chaotic, but intentional.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-20: Your gaze catches faint traces carved into the scorched stone. Sigils drawn in something darker than soot.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-21: "Blood," you whisper. "Old and willingly given. He didn't survive, he transcended."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-22: Choose “Something's wrong. His soul isn't here.”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-23: You stare into the eyes. Yet what stares back feels distant, hollow.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-24: "His body breathes, but the soul's elsewhere," you whisper. "Bound, maybe... or borrowed."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-25: Torchlight reveals a man slumped against the chamber wall, his wrists chained to the stone.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-26: His skin is pale and bruised, and his clothes hang in tatters. Despite his injuries, he watches you warily.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-27: A torn green tunic hangs beneath his faded cloak. The iron shackles have cut deep into his wrists.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-28: At the sound of footsteps, he lifts his head, blinking into the sudden light. His lips crack as they part, the voice a rasp: "...You're not one of them... are you?"
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-29: "Who are you, and what are you doing here?"
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-3: The violet-robed cleric by the desk freezes, then slowly turns. His eyes lock onto yours. Sharp, calculating. Around his hands, dark energy begins to swirl, pulsing with raw, destructive power.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-30: Choose “Who are you, and what are you doing here?”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-31: He flinches, jaw set, eyes sweeping over your weapons with suspicion. "Names are for friends... or fools. Prove you're not an enemy first."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-32: Khelebar sent us. If you are Jacob.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-33: I believe we have found your message. You are Jacob, right?
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-34: We mean you no harm. We're here just for treasures.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-35: Choose “We mean you no harm. We're here just for treasures.”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-36: He studies your faces for a long beat, silence stretching.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-37: "Maybe you're not enemy. Maybe just stubborn grave-robbers. Fine. But if your words rot, I'll smell it."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-38: "Do you have some information which can help us?"
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-39: Choose “Khelebar sent us. If you are Jacob.”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-4: "You dare step into my sanctum? You cannot kill me, worm." His voice drips with scorn, each word a lash of contempt.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-40: "Khelebar... ha. Of course. The old man still watches his woods."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-41: "I'm Jacob. Follower of the Old Ways. I chased whispers of blood rites, something ancient turning in its sleep beneath this mausoleum."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-42: "I thought I could stop it. Or at least find out what it is. Instead, I ended up chained like a dog."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-43: "The Source... no one should face it alone."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-44: "What do you know about this mausoleum?"
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-46: Choose “I believe we have found your message. You are Jacob, right?”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-47: His gaze catches the script, a faint crack of a smile pulling at split lips. "That's mine. You followed the same trail, then. Good."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-48: "Name's Jacob. I hunted the evil whispers of blood. Found the way in. Then the cult dragged me under."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-49: Select “Do you have some information which can help us?” / “What do you know about this mausoleum?”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-5: "Something's wrong. His soul isn't here." (Requires Voidcaller)
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-50: "I have some. This place was once a sanctum of silence, a hall for the dead to rest."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-51: "Now it stinks of them. Shrines fouled, crypts turned to cages, walls carved with their sigils."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-52: "The Blood Order came to tend something. To guard it."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-53: "Deep below lies what they call the Source. Well of blood magic. To reach it, you'll need three keys. Each kept by one of their high priests, on different levels of this wretched place."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-56: "The cult whispers Source like it's a god. I don't know what it is. Only that it breathes."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-57: "To reach it, you'll need three keys. Each kept by one of their high priests, on different levels of this wretched place."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-59: Jacob pushes himself upright, one hand brushing the chains now slack. His gaze lingers on the corridor, then back to you.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-6: "These markings... it was a blood rite. He changed himself." (Requires Blood Mage)
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-60: "Grateful, truly. I'd fight with you if I could," he rasps, the hint of a smile bitter as iron. "But like this... I'd be dead weight."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-61: "I'll limp back to my cabin. If it still stands."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-62: His eyes harden, a last spark in the ruin of his face. "Please. Do what I couldn't. End the Source."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-63: With a tug on his torn mantle, he turns for the long road home.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-65: Ask about the axe. "We found this in the forest. Is it yours?"
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-66: Choose “Ask about the axe. "We found this in the forest. Is it yours?"”
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-67: "My axe! I thought it lost. Thank you... I don't know how to repay you, but I feel whole again. Spirits guide you, friends."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-68: At the doorway, he stops and glances over his shoulder one last time.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-69: "When it's done... stop by the cabin. I owe you more than just a pint."
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-7: "Quick shot. Aim for the heart." (Requires Ranger)
maps.points.mausoleum_2.dialogue-70: He disappears into the passage, moving slowly and leaning against the wall for support.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.f17.detail: Search for the coffin on the altar at (1, 1).

maps.points.mausoleum_2.n02.detail: From beyond, a low murmur seeps through. The cadence rises and falls like waves of blood.
maps.points.mausoleum_2.title: Rescue Jacob
maps.points.mausoleum_2.wall-sign.flame_:
A flame is lying, It blocks the path. Its warmth is false, Like scars drawn on the surface.
The real flames burn with equal intensity. The breath of life must protect its light.
Let no flame burn your soul.
